name: mm-mcp
description: Read, search and post in Mattermost as yourself or a bot.
long_description: mm-mcp connects an MCP client to one Mattermost server, as the person or bot whose token it is given. It is read-only unless writes are allowed, and a tool that writes asks you before it acts.

mattermost_url.title: Mattermost address
mattermost_url.description: The address you open Mattermost at, such as https://chat.example.com.

mattermost_token.title: Token
mattermost_token.description: A personal access token, a bot token, or a session token.

allow_writes.title: Allow posting
allow_writes.description: Offer the tools that post and change things. Each one still asks you before it acts.
